title: Automated invoice reminders
description: Send scheduled email/SMS reminders for unpaid invoices at 3/7/14 days overdue.
customer_signal: Top-3 request in last survey; 38 support tickets asking how to chase late payments

title: AI job-notes summary
description: Summarize a technician's voice or text notes into a clean job record and next steps.
customer_signal: Requested in 9 customer interviews; competitors starting to ship similar features

title: Online booking page
description: Public booking page where homeowners can request a job slot that syncs to the calendar.
customer_signal: Requested by 21 accounts; common churn reason in exit surveys

title: QuickBooks Online sync
description: Two-way sync of customers and invoices with QuickBooks Online.
customer_signal: Most-requested integration; 54 tickets about double data entry

title: Offline mode for mobile app
description: Let technicians create and edit jobs without connectivity and sync later.
customer_signal: Complaints from rural users; 12 app-store reviews mention it

title: Card-on-file payments
description: Securely store a customer's card to charge deposits and final balances faster.
customer_signal: Requested by payments team to grow payment volume; 15 tickets

title: One-click quote-to-invoice
description: Convert an accepted quote into an invoice without re-entering line items.
customer_signal: Most-watched item on the public roadmap; 61 upvotes

title: Dark mode
description: Dark theme for the web and mobile apps.
customer_signal: Frequent but low-urgency request in app-store reviews

title: Drag-and-drop team scheduling
description: Dispatcher calendar to assign and move jobs across multiple technicians.
customer_signal: Requested by multi-crew accounts (about 10% of base)

title: "On my way" SMS notifications
description: Technician taps once to text the customer an ETA.
customer_signal: Requested in 14 interviews; reduces no-access visits

title: AI quote drafting
description: Draft a quote from a job description or photo using the customer's own price list.
customer_signal: Strong interest in 2 concept tests; accuracy concerns raised by testers

title: Custom reporting dashboard
description: Configurable reports on revenue, jobs, and technician productivity.
customer_signal: Requested by larger accounts; unclear which reports matter most

title: Multi-currency invoicing
description: Invoice in currencies other than the account's home currency.
customer_signal: Requested by a small number of cross-border contractors

title: Customer self-service portal
description: Homeowners view quotes and invoices and pay online in one place.
customer_signal: Mixed feedback in interviews; depends on stored payment methods

title: Automated review requests
description: Text customers a review link after a job is marked complete.
customer_signal: Requested by 18 accounts for local SEO; builds on SMS sending
